$comment: The one row grid of every cmux NEXT menu (Leo 2026-10-21, on Lawrence's screenshots of the sidebar group menu and the pane [+] menu: "idk if we generalized the left alignment across all stuff yet"). Native macOS menu metrics (Leo 2026-10-21, on the chat's right-click menu: "so much ... padding ... all over the place"): content at AppKit's own leading, where its separators start, and a state column only in a menu with a checkmark. Points from the menu's leading edge, or from its trailing edge for `trailing`. Right-click and ⋮ menus, the group editors, the palette's menus, page popups and the webviews' menus all read these. scripts/cmux-next/gen-menu-metrics.py writes the CSS copy (--cmux-menu-<name> in webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css) and checks the hand-written Swift copy (CmuxNextDesign/MenuMetrics.swift); scripts/cmux-next/check-menu-metrics.py fails a menu that sets its own.

metrics.name: highlightInset
metrics.for: the hover highlight's distance from the menu's edges

metrics.name: separatorInset
metrics.for: a separator's distance from the menu's edges, on both sides: AppKit's own, where a row's content starts

metrics.name: stateX
metrics.for: a checkmark or dash, in a menu that has one

metrics.name: stateIconX
metrics.for: where a row's icon starts in a menu with a checkmark or dash

metrics.name: iconX
metrics.for: where a row's icon starts (its title without an icon column): AppKit's own leading

metrics.name: iconSize
metrics.for: the box an icon fits in, its shape kept

metrics.name: iconGap
metrics.for: between the icon column and the text

metrics.name: trailing
metrics.for: a shortcut's or submenu chevron's distance from the trailing edge

metrics.name: shortcutGap
metrics.for: the least room between a title and its shortcut or chevron
